title: PARAMANU: Compact and Competitive Monolingual Language Models for Low-Resource Morphologically Rich Indian Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating tokenizer fertility scores and zero-shot performance on downstream NLP benchmarks (MMLU, ARC, Belebele, XCOPA, XStoryCloze, HellaSwag, XNLI) across multiple Indian languages to demonstrate the English-centric bias, language confusion, and tokenizer over-segmentation present in existing multilingual models.
